result:
Admins can now pin and unpin a discussion, and the list shows pinned discussions first with a Pinned badge. I did not run tests, lint or the app, as you asked, so none of this has been run or type-checked.

The last lint hook message flagged `pin-discussion.tsx:4`, the `useNotifications` import. I had already removed that import, and the file as it stands no longer has it. I think the hook ran before the fix landed, but I did not re-run it, so that is unconfirmed.

- **Mock API:** `pinned` is a new boolean field on the discussion model in `src/testing/mocks/db.ts`, and in the `Discussion` type in `src/types/api.ts`. A new admin-only endpoint, `PATCH /discussions/:id/pin`, sets it and saves it. The list endpoint now sorts pinned first before paginating, so pinned items stay on page 1 across pages.
- **Pin button:** `api/pin-discussion.ts` holds the request, its Zod input schema and the `usePinDiscussion` hook. The hook also shows the success notification, as the feature rules require. The hook refreshes both the single discussion and the list. The new `PinDiscussion` component in `components/pin-discussion.tsx` shows the Pin or Unpin button to admins only. It sits next to the edit button on the discussion page.
- **Badge:** I added a small shared `Badge` component in `components/ui/badge`. The discussions list shows it next to the title, and the discussion page shows it by the date.

Existing mock data saved in localStorage has no `pinned` value. I expect it to default to false when it loads, but I did not check.
